## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2025-09-02: S-1/A files the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.7.
- 2025-09-11: IPO closes; Tax Receivable Agreement executed by Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc., Black Rock Coffee Holdings, LLC, and the Cynosure / Co-Founder-trust / individual TRA Parties.
- 2025-09-16: 8-K reports IPO closing and files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2.

## Explanation

The TRA originates from Black Rock Coffee Bar's September 11, 2025 Up-C IPO, with the Cynosure-affiliated sponsor entities, Co-Founder family gifting trusts (Davis, Brand, Spellmeyer, Pereboom), and individual executives and directors as TRA Parties. Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. pays 85% of the Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit on Section 754 basis step-ups arising from redemptions, direct exchanges, and other exchanges of Common Units, plus imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. The contract has not been amended or terminated. The TRA liability stood at $42.5M as of March 31, 2026, having grown from initial recognition through additional Q1 2026 unit exchanges. See `contract_log.md` for the full party list and same-contract reasoning across the form-of and executed versions.
